profile:
COMPANY NAME: CXAI
INDUSTRY: Workplace Technology / Employee Experience (EX) / SaaS
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An enterprise Employee Experience Platform (mobile app) that integrates desk and room booking, office mapping, internal communications, and IoT resource management to streamline daily workplace workflows.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Large enterprises, specifically Fortune 500 companies, and organizations with hybrid or digital workplaces.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise
KEY FEATURES:
- Desk and room booking with spatial mapping
- Internal communications and proximity messaging
- Office mapping and "Find a Colleague" functionality
- Amenities, reservations, and event management
- Manager dashboards for workplace analytics and utilization
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- Built on customer experience (CX) principles and powered by AI
- Acts as a "concierge" app to reduce digital friction and save employee time
- Proven to boost employee engagement and optimize office space utilization
- Recognized with Gold GLOBEE® awards for best user experience and smart solutions
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium
